questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully in the frame (e.g., 00:09), there are clearly three writing instruments arranged in a row.
The pens are not aligned identically. The rightmost pen has its cap at the top, while the middle pen has its cap at the bottom, and the leftmost pen points its tip downwards.
The leftmost pen appears grey/silver and uncapped (like a mechanical pencil), while the other two have black caps and translucent barrels.
The leftmost pen shows a bare writing tip (or pencil lead) at the bottom, whereas the middle pen is capped at the bottom and the right pen is capped at the top.
The board moves continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board relative to each other as it moves.

parsed.reason: The video shows multiple anomalies: the pens are not identical (the left one appears to be a different type/uncapped), they are not all capped consistently, and they have different orientations (caps pointing in different directions).
